mapper.select: select notice_id as noticeId, target_type as targetType, target_id as targetId, include_children as includeChildren from sys_notice_audience where notice_id = #{noticeId} order by target_type, target_id

mapper.select: select dept_id as id, dept_name as label, concat('部门 / ', coalesce(dept_type, '未分类')) as description from sys_dept where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' order by parent_id, order_num, dept_id
select role_id as id, role_name as label, concat('角色 / ', role_key) as description from sys_role where del_flag = '0' and status = '0' order by role_sort, role_id
